Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 8, 9, 11, 60, 61, 79, 85, 91, 103, 107, 109, 115, 125, 127, 131, 135, 139, 145, 153, 154
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 14
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"
    • G: (a/u) NB ēnē a. 'fear the eyes' = "with an eye to, in consideration of"
    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB
    • Št: pass. of Š
    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB
  • Lines: 90, 114
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20II

adīru I

  • Meaning: "fear" M/jB;
  • Lines: 87, 111, 138
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%ABru%20I

aggiš I

  • Meaning: "furiously" Bab., NA;
  • Lines: 12
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aggi%C5%A1%20I

agāgu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) furious" Bab.
    • G: (a/u; stat. agug) of god, human
    • Gtn: "be steadfastly angry"?
    • D: stat. only "is very angry"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: "get angry"
  • Lines: 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ag%C4%81gu%20I

ahrâtaš I

  • Meaning: "for ever after" j/NB(lit.); a. nišī, a. ūmī "for posterity";
  • Lines: 3
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahr%C3%A2ta%C5%A1%20I

ai I

  • Meaning: (before consonant), â, ya "not"
  • Lines: 91, 115, 162
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20I

akāšu I

  • Meaning: "to walk, go" Bab., O/MA
    • G: (u/u) [DU] of messenger, person, snake
    • Gt: "go away"
    • D: "drive away, expel" person, disease, demon; ~ "press, push away" part of liver; OA stat. of tablet "is mislaid" ?
    • Dtn: iter. of D
    • Dt: pass. of D "be expelled, driven off"
  • Logograms: DU
  • Lines: 152
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81%C5%A1u%20I

ali I

  • Meaning: "where?" OAkk, Ass., O/jB
  • Lines: 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ali%20I

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 20
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 14, 77, 81, 105, 140, 142, 149
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

alālu III

  • Meaning: O/jB
    • G: not attested
    • Gt: "to sing a joyful song; boast"
    • Š: "exult, celebrate"
    • Štn: iter. of Š
  • Lines: 145, 147
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81lu%20III

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 25, 68, 134, 137
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 2, 4, 10, 46, 72, 94, 96, 120, 135, 153, 154
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

anantu I

  • Meaning: pl. an(a)nātu "battle, strife" Bab.(lit.)
  • Lines: 4, 36
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/anantu%20I

annû I

  • Meaning: OB occas. with nunation "this, those" [j/NB NE; ŠEŠ (for m. pl. annûti)]; OB f. sg. annītum "this matter"; annītam lā annītam 'this one, not this one', "one way or another"; a. ū a. "various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";
  • Logograms: ,
  • Lines: 68
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ann%C3%BB%20I

Anu I

  • Meaning: "An(um)" (the god of heaven) OAkk, Bab. [AN; NB d60]; of Ištar anātima "you are supreme deity";
  • Logograms: AN, NB
  • Lines: 96, 105
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Anu%20I

Anunnaku I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: 42, 121
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Anunnaku%20I

anāhu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) tired"
    • G: (a/a) stat. "becomes tired", "makes an effort, strives"; of buildings etc. "become dilapidated"
    • Gtn: iter. of G jB med., of limbs, person

    • D: ~ G [DAB; DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] also "enclose, bind, set" with metal (bands); "fasten" roofbeams, thread; "occupy" city; "block" road; "claim" protection (kidinnu)
    • Dtn: iter. "repeatedly take possession of"
    • Dt: pass. of D Am. "be captured"
    • Š: caus. of G [DAB] "direct" s.o.'s attention (pānū) towards (ana); "equip, provide with" income, pasturage, water; often ellipt. "put in place, install" door; "launch" ship; "post" guard; "install" gate-sculptures; "settle" inhabitants; "cause to catch" fire, "ignite"; "make s.o. (start to) do s.th."
    • Štn: pass. of Š NB of work "be started on"
    • Št2: "make o.s. take", OA "gather up" silver; OB "get" troops, animals, tools "ready"; "execute" plan, decision
    • N: pass. of G [DAB]; ~ Gt OA, OB "seize one another", "litigate"
    • Ntn: ~ Gt "be interlocked, grown together"; of teeth "lock each other"
